native.ub_review_profile: Selected USB2/USB3 published parameter rules or independently qualified USB4 tunnel/other implementation.
native.ub_proposal_mode: Source literature baseline proposals versus observed device configuration.
native.ub_speed: Actual negotiated downstream USB link mode, not connector appearance.
native.ub_transfer: Actual endpoint transfer type, independent of USB version.
native.ub_direction: Endpoint direction relative to host; control is bidirectional.
native.ub_device_state: Actual enumeration/configuration state; default address0 is not configured.
native.ub_interrupt_usage: Actual USB3 interrupt periodic versus notification semantics.
native.ub_power_profile: Power contract separate from data rate. Type-C/PD need independent actual source.
native.ub_vbus_revision: Actual old USB2 voltage definition versus reviewed VBUS Max Limit ECN.
native.ub_outcome: Actual transfer/application result; USB handshake is not fresh functional success.
native.ub_encoding: Actual selected PHY encoding; USB4 PAM3 aggregate is not USB2 NRZI.
native.ub_role: Actual USB data-path host, device or hub.
native.ub_link_bps: Actual nominal per-direction aggregate link signaling rate, excluding encoding efficiency and tunneling allocation.
native.ub_lane_bps: Actual single lane rate; dual lane aggregate is separate.
native.ub_lanes: Actual negotiated lane count, not available connector pairs.
native.ub_reverse_bps: Actual opposite direction rate for asymmetric USB4.
native.ub_device_address: Actual assigned7-bit device address;0 only defaultstate.
native.ub_endpoint: Actual endpoint number0..15; EP0control has no endpoint descriptor.
native.ub_endpoint_address_raw: Actual bEndpointAddress byte with reserved bits zero and directionbit7.
native.ub_max_packet_bytes: Actual decoded endpoint maximum data packet; not whole USB transfer/application length.
native.ub_packet_bytes: Actual current data packet payload, may be zero/short.
native.ub_transfer_bytes: Actual whole application transfer may span many packets.
native.ub_peer_buffer_bytes: Actual device/class buffer for full transfer, independent maxpacket.
native.ub_max_packet_raw: Actual USB2 wMaxPacketSize including high-bandwidth bits, not decoded bytes.
native.ub_transactions: Actual USB2 packets/opportunities per microframe; qualified eUSB2 IN can reach6.
native.ub_binterval: Actual bInterval descriptor value; units and exponent depend speed/type.
native.ub_interval_us: Actual requested periodic interval from bInterval; not guaranteed functional completion.
native.ub_frame_us: Actual1ms frame or125us high-speed microframe/service bus interval.
native.ub_periodic_allocation_percent: Actual aggregate periodic schedule reservation, not default NIS warning limit.
native.ub_bytes_per_interval: Actual selected periodic descriptor reservation bytes; transferred amount can be less.
native.ub_bmaxburst: USB3 zero-based maximum burst packets0..15, not retrycount.
native.ub_mult: USB3 legacy ISO companion zero-based multiplier0..2; ignored with SSPcompanion.
native.ub_maxstreams: USB3 bulk companion MaxStreams0..16;0 means no streams.
native.ub_wbytes_per_interval: USB3 companion16-bit reservation;1 when SSPISOcompanion,0 bulk/control.
native.ub_dwbytes_per_interval: Actual SSP/eUSB2 companion32-bit reservation in qualified mode.
native.ub_ssp_iso_max_bytes: Actual source-qualified SSP capacity bound from rate/lane revision; not fixed48Kforall.
native.ub_bcdusb: Actual device descriptor BCD release, not speed alone.
native.ub_ep0_maxpacket_raw: Actual USB3 bMaxPacketSize0 exponent9 for512, USB2 directly encoded.
native.ub_hub_levels: Actual device path hub levels; USB2/USB3 limit5 interveninghubs.
native.ub_unit_load_ma: Actual source-qualified data legacy power unit; USB2=100,USB3single150/dual250.
native.ub_current_ma: Actual peak device sink current, not average/defaultconsumption.
native.ub_vbus_v: Actual measured/specified supply at selected source/consumer boundary.
native.ub_wire_bits: Actual whole physical occupation bound with tokens,handshakes,stuffing/coding and gaps.
native.ub_wire_us: Actual physical occupation bound, separate aggregate signal rate.
native.ub_tunnel_allocation_bps: Actual allocated USB4 data tunnel bandwidth, not entire80/120Glink.
native.ub_transport_ms: Actual complete host schedule,hub/TT,wire,tunnel and retries.
native.ub_deadline_ms: Independent function deadline, not bInterval guarantee.
native.ub_age_ms: Actual data age at consuming function.
native.ub_double_eusb2: Actual directly connected inbox native eUSB2 doubleISO IN capability, not allhighspeed.
native.ub_direct_inbox: Actual direct inbox native eUSB2 device and qualified hostsoftware.
native.ub_ssp_iso_companion: Actual SSPISO companion descriptor present and understood by selected host.
native.ub_retry_enabled: Actual link retransmission policy; ISO has no data retransmission guarantee.
native.ub_tt_required: Actual low/fullspeed device on highspeed hub requires qualified transactiontranslator.
native.ub_schedule_verified: Actual host whole endpoint aggregate schedule evidence.
native.ub_path_verified: Actual all devices, hubs, TT, PHY/tunnel and driver path proof.
native.ub_data_accepted: Actual current application data accepted against own function.
native.ub_device_source: Actual host/device and mutually selected PHY/endpoint capabilities.
native.ub_schedule_source: Actual host schedule,buffer,queue and driver service bound.
native.ub_physical_source: Actual cables/ports/power/PHY, not connector implies speed.
native.ub_tunnel_source: Actual USB4 routers/adapters/allocation/encapsulation and bound endpoint path.
native.ub_ssp_source: Actual SSPISO companion reservation and source-dependent rate/lane maximum.
native.payload_bytes: Actual applicationtransfer bytes, possibly manypackets. Actual endpoint/type/speed/descriptors, buffer, schedule and USB4tunnel envelope separate.
